visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with brown hair in pigtails and a white blouse holds a white bowl of soup, looking into it with an inquisitive expression. The background is a brightly lit, warm indoor kitchen with wooden cabinets. Large text overlays in traditional Chinese and English appear at the bottom. (2) A sharp close-up shot focuses on a plate of fresh, green California grapes on a wooden table. The lighting is natural and bright, highlighting the glossy skins of the fruit. The woman is briefly seen examining the grapes with a smile, showing a high level of engagement. (3) The scene shifts to a cooking montage where a glass pot sits on a blue flame on a Sakura induction stove. The woman adds chicken pieces, ginger slices, and a splash of rice wine from a small dish. Finally, she adds a large container of green grapes into the simmering broth. (4) While the soup simmers, the woman eats a raw grape, her expression showing enjoyment. She then lifts a spoonful of the finished soup, containing a pale grape and chicken meat, to the camera. The background kitchen is well-organized with various utensils visible on the counter. (5) In the final segment, the woman tastes the soup from a small bowl, looking thoughtful and then surprised by the taste. She holds the plate of grapes forward in a presentation gesture. Subtitles continue to reflect her enthusiastic review of the unique flavor combination.
